newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Spectrum raises A$10.4 mln in issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Spectrum raises A$10.4 mln in issue.

text.p: Telecommunications services reseller Spectrum Network Systems Ltd said on Thursday it would raise A$10.4 million in a 1-for-3 rights issue.
The rights issue is underwritten by Prudential-Bache Securities Australia Ltd, Spectrum said.

Spectrum managing director Bob Hansford said in a statement the capital would be used to continue the growth strategy of the group to augment working capital and to assist in starting to establish a switched network.
Spectrum shares last trade on Wednesday, when it fell two cents over the day to close at 54 cents.
